gpu_tip: ~137GB total at 128K context — the highest-quality quantization, and the only one that keeps the MTP layer at Q8_0 rather than Q4_0. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4080) runs the attention and shared-expert layers at full speed while llama.cpp's expert offloading puts the routed experts in a 192GB DDR5 kit.
mac_tip: Needs ~137GB — exceeds every MacBook Pro; a Mac Studio (M3 Ultra with 192GB+ unified memory) is required.
